div.div: 2 هٰذَا مِمَّا يُخَبِّثُ النَّفْسَ , (TA,) or ↓ يُخْبِثُ , النفس, (so in a copy of the A, [but the former I believe to be the right,]) This is of the things that cause the soul [or stomach] to become heavy, or to heave, or become agitated by a tendency to vomit. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
